build_masked_lm_model: build a MaskedLMModel instance using build_model with args and a fairseq task
build_bert_base_architecture: build a BERT base architecture with 12 layers, 768 embed dim, and 12 attention heads
build_bert_large_architecture: build a BERT large architecture with 24 layers, 1024 embed dim, and 16 attention heads
run_masked_lm_encoder_forward: run the MaskedLMEncoder forward pass with src_tokens and optional segment_labels to get logits
configure_xlm_architecture: configure an XLM base architecture with 6 layers, 1024 embed dim, and no sentence loss
